description: This MATLAB script reads and processes data files related to battery cell properties, cooling system statistics, and charge/discharge throughput. It generates various plots for cell capacities, states, histograms, and cooling system metrics, and saves figures. It also handles multiple CSV data files and performs analysis of thermal management efficiency and energy throughput.
